statement: In a regulatory-document QA benchmark, base-retriever choice materially changes results and no paradigm dominates: hybrid BM25+dense RRF achieves the highest overall performance, yet BM25 outperforms hybrid on multihop queries (ROUGE-L 0.304 vs. 0.239), suggesting reciprocal rank fusion may be less effective than sparse retrieval for multi-document reasoning on domain-specific regulatory corpora.

evidence.quote: BM25 outperforms hybrid on multihop queries
suggesting that Reciprocal Rank Fusion may be less effective than sparse retrieval for multi-document reasoning on domain-specific regulatory corpora
Hybrid retrieval achieves the highest overall performance
their behaviour on narrow financial corpora such as regulatory and procedural documents remains understudied
